name: @dsh-rc/server
description: Zero-knowledge WebSocket relay for DSH Remote Control. Routes sealed records between the host plugin and paired clients; never sees plaintext.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/bundle/main.js --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire as __drcRequire } from 'node:module';const require = __drcRequire(import.meta.url);"
